result.description: All-in-one marketing platform: funnel builder, email marketing, courses, communities, affiliate, and e-commerce.
result.auth_detail: Per-account Public API key sent in the X-API-Key header. No OAuth (OAuth only 'planned' for MCP). Each user creates own key (up to 3) in Settings > MCP & API keys.
result.access_detail: Any user creates their own API key in account Settings; no app review, partner status, or listing needed. Free plan never expires and needs no credit card. Pricing page extracted no explicit plan restriction on API; only an 'API requests per minute' row (per-plan values not captured), so rate limits differ by tier but no paid gate found. Help article states no plan restriction.
result.api_notes: REST at api.systeme.io/api. Help article lists: contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, campaigns, email stats, funnels, price plans/coupons, courses, modules, lectures, communities, automation rules, subscriptions, webhooks, digital/physical products, offers, calendar bookings, SMS templates. Cursor pagination (startingAfter), 429 rate limits with headers.

evidence.quote: To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the `X-API-Key` header of each request.
Give your key a name, set an expiration date, and click **Save** (4).
The free plan never expires and does not require a credit card.
Use the `startingAfter` parameter to specify the ID of the last item you received.
The Systeme.io MCP server currently supports **contact and newsletter management**.
This is an **initial release implementation** and does not yet support the recommended authentication method (OAuth).
